prerequisites: Dimension and basis of a vector space

learning_outcomes.text: Develop basic notions in analysis and linear algebra to acquire a reasoning method and calculation techniques to approach the teachings of the final cycle.

syllabus_topics: Complex numbers: algebraic and trigonometric forms, square roots
Geometric, arithmetico-geometric sequences, sequences of the form
Series with positive terms, convergence theorems, absolute convergence
Simple integral: integration by parts, change of variables, primitives of rational fractions
First and second order differential equations
Determinants. Inverse of a square matrix
Eigenvalues and eigenvectors of a square matrix
Diagonalization. Application to differential systems and recurrent sequences
bibliography: Mathématiques IUT 1ère année - 3ème édition Thierry ALHALEL and al. DUNOD
degree: Diplôme d'ingénieur Centrale Nantes, spécialité Mécanique (apprentissage)
